items.h: Last Weekend for the Jack-O-Lantern Spectacular at the Zoo
items.sum: More than 5,000 carved pumpkins line 'The Great Pun-Kin Trail' at Roger Williams Park Zoo through Saturday, with an adults-only Last Call on Sunday.

items.h: Rhode Island documentary “The Pizza Principal” announces its premiere
items.sum: Filmmaker Kirk Benttinen’s November 20 Providence screening will introduce the film alongside shorts through his RI Docs project.

items.h: I-195 will close in both directions for bridge demolition November 6–7
items.sum: RIDOT plans a closure near East Providence’s Taunton Avenue interchange beginning at 10 p.m. Friday, with all lanes expected to reopen by noon Saturday.

items.h: Newport County holiday-assistance registration is open
items.sum: The MLK Community Center is accepting in-person applications for holiday food and children’s gifts; Thanksgiving registration ends November 13.

items.h: Central Falls teacher Briana Jones wins a $25,000 Milken award
items.sum: She becomes the city’s first recipient of the national educator recognition.

items.h: Newport sailor Ben Rosenberg joins America’s Cup challenger ARC Team USA
items.sum: The local sailor will serve as an AC75 sailor and coaching-support analyst for the American campaign.

items.h: Newport preservation projects receive Rhody Awards recognition
items.sum: Honorees include Castle Hill’s fire restoration, a lead-paint guidance project, and Salve Regina’s Michael Semenza; public voting continues through noon October 30.

items.h: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Rhode Island marks 60 years
items.sum: Its anniversary breakfast in Lincoln raised more than $100,000 for mentoring programs.

items.h: Traditional snow days return in Tiverton schools
items.sum: The School Committee voted to discontinue electronic learning days for weather closures, with missed time made up when necessary.

items.h: Aquidneck Island’s long-discussed rail-with-trail project advances
items.sum: Partners are developing a path alongside the Newport Secondary corridor and seeking public input, including a November 1 community train ride.

items.h: Costco selects Smithfield for its proposed first Rhode Island store
items.sum: The Route 116 location remains subject to approvals, with a proposed 2028 opening and more than 200 potential jobs.

items.h: Wakefield’s Looney Tunes II will close after more than 50 years
items.sum: The record store plans to shut its doors November 30; nearby gift shop Nico Scout also plans to close its storefront.
